rv.q: While the three main threads don’t exactly coalesce into a fully integrated whole, there is a genuine sense that the playwright has worked to weave them.
It rewards attention and offers something fresh to the debate, and some overfamiliar stories.

cn.t: Mixed reviews greet this 90-minute gig economy drama, with critics split on whether Wilkinson's ambitious exploration of London's working class delivers on its bold promises despite energetic performances.
